software_engineer.jd_text:
TechCorp is looking for a Software Engineer to join our backend team.

Requirements:
- Strong knowledge of Python (Python 3)
- Hands-on experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
- Version control proficiency in Git

Nice to have:
- Familiarity with containerization in Docker
- Experience deploying to AWS (Amazon Web Services)

ai_ml_intern.jd_text:
NeuralDynamics Lab is hiring an AI/ML Research Intern.

Required Qualifications:
- Strong proficiency in Python for data science
- Core understanding of Machine Learning algorithms
- Strong foundation in Probability and Statistics

Bonus Points:
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow frameworks
- Experience with Scikit-Learn or Pandas

data_analyst.jd_text:
InsightAnalytics seeks a Data Analyst.

What You Will Need:
- Proficiency in SQL querying and data extraction
- Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel (spreadsheets, formulas)
- Practical experience with exploratory Data Analysis

Preferred:
- Data visualization using Power BI or Tableau
